description: This file defines a generic cache interface for key-value storage, supporting asynchronous retrieval, invalidation, and thread-safe operations.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A generic interface for a cache that stores key-value pairs with support for asynchronous get operations, invalidation, and retrieval as a thread-safe map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture that will complete with the value associated with the specified key, or an empty Optional if none exists.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the key if it exists in the cache, returning a CompletableFuture with an Optional, without calling a cache loader.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves the value associated with the key, returning an Optional with the value or empty if not present.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the cache entry for the given key, returning true if an entry was present and invalidated.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates the given value with the specified key in the cache asynchronously, without waiting for the update to complete.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe, mutable view of the cache as a map. Modifications directly affect the cache.
